1560850330953195552.headline: AFTERLIFE HIGH ROLLER EVENT Ready for something a little different? This is a pure player-funded event. No guild seed money — the entire pot is built by you. HOW IT WORKS • 5,000 platinum = 1 entry on
1560850330953195552.body: AFTERLIFE HIGH ROLLER EVENT Ready for something a little different? This is a pure player-funded event. No guild seed money — the entire pot is built by you. HOW IT WORKS • 5,000 platinum = 1 entry on the wheel • Every additional 5,000 platinum = 1 extra entry • Maximum 25,000 platinum (5 entries) per person • Each entry is assigned a number as payments come in (example: 1, 3-5, 35-39, etc.). • Special Rule: Guildies may buy a ticket for any member. Can't enter on your own? Ask a friend to enter your name! Please specify if you are buying a ticket for another member in your comment. A random number will be drawn in-game. The drawing can be attended live, will be livestreamed, and will be screen-recorded for anyone who can’t make it. Payout: • 90% of the total pot goes to the winner • 10% is retained by the guild for future giveaways RULES • Open to EVERYONE • Discord nickname must match your in-game main • You must comment in this channel and pay the plat to be entered • Payments go to ⏰ SCHEDULE • Entry & Payment Deadline: Tuesday, October 20 at 9:00 PM EDT • Drawing will be held shortly after payments are confirmed Drop a comment below to claim your spot(s), then send the plat. The more people that jump in, the bigger the pot gets. This is our first time running an event like this. If it’s popular, we may follow up with a higher-stakes version that allows 10 or more entries per person. Let’s see how high we can push it.

1559021635971846216.headline: Akuzay’s Last Name Auction (a.k.a. “Who Gets to Brand the Meme?”) The guild has spoken, Kinzo has given the green light, and our newly minted Junior Officer Akuzay has officially put his last name up
1559021635971846216.body: Akuzay’s Last Name Auction (a.k.a. “Who Gets to Brand the Meme?”) The guild has spoken, Kinzo has given the green light, and our newly minted Junior Officer Akuzay has officially put his last name up for grabs. As part of his sacred Junior Officer initiation ritual, Akuzay must endure the ultimate trial: letting the guild decide what comes after his name. Want him to be Akuzay McFartsalot? Akuzay Bonkmaster? Akuzay Wiggletoes? Akuzay Clutchfail? (clearly I'm not the creative type....this is where I need YOU!) If your wallet is thick enough… it can happen. This is a Discord-only auction. Bids posted in guild chat will not be counted. All proceeds go straight into the guild bank. No cut. No funny business. Just pure, unfiltered guild funding and one very public identity crisis. -------------------- THE PRIZE Exclusive naming rights to Akuzay’s last name. Winner gets to decide the official last name that will be used in Discord, in-game, and wherever else the poor bastard shows up. (Yes, he has already agreed. Yes, he is already regretting it. Yes, this is officially part of his initiation.) -------------------- HOW THE AUCTION WORKS • This is a Discord-only auction. • Drop your bid in the designated channel as a comment (example: Bid: 25,000p). • You may raise your own bid at any time. • Highest bid at the close of the auction wins. • Ties will be broken by earliest timestamp. -------------------- RULES & FINE PRINT • Minimum opening bid: 20,000p • Bids must be in platinum (no “I’ll pay you in Tumpy Tonics” or IOUs). • Winner has 24 hours after auction close to parcel the full amount to Aggrivon. Failing to pay means the next highest bid automatically wins the naming rights. • If the chosen last name is denied by the EQL devs, the winner may select a new name. • Akuzay reserves the right to cry about it in guild chat and in Discord. That’s non-negotiable… and also part of the initiation. -------------------- ⏰ TIMELINE Auction is LIVE NOW. Closes in 48 hours. -------------------- HOW TO ENTER Just post your bid below. That’s it. Highest number wins the right to scar this man for life… and complete his Junior Officer initiation in the most permanent way possible. Future generations of Afterlife members will look at the Discord member list and ask, “How the hell did he come up with that?” And the answer will be: YOU All platinum goes to the guild bank to keep funding events, giveaways, and whatever nonsense we cook up next. Good luck. May the richest (and most unhinged) bidder win. — Kinzo approved, Aggrivon sponsored, and Akuzay is already preparing his resignation letter (and his new name tag).

1557252322458083338.headline: GUILD PROMOTIONS — Three New Junior Officers · Afterlife, Freeport Server Please join me in congratulating our three newest teammates — our first round of Junior Officer promotions. We promote from wi
1557252322458083338.body: GUILD PROMOTIONS — Three New Junior Officers · Afterlife, Freeport Server Please join me in congratulating our three newest teammates — our first round of Junior Officer promotions. We promote from within! 1. — Junior Officer #1 Half Elf · BRD/CLR/SHM * #1 contributor (guildie supported) across guild events, including the 5,294 Deepwater Ink. * Final push that closed our 10,000+ ink overall guild quest over one week. * Countless hours helping guildies through the guild quests Kinzo posts. * Supports the officers, helps recruit, and helped make the Kinzo hits 50 comic. * Our very first Junior Officer — paving the way for many more. 2. — Junior Officer #2 Barbarian · WAR/SHM/WIZ * Epic Achievement in Commerce & Trade — countless hours farming, selling and trading. * A true philanthropist: hundreds of thousands of plat donated to 's giveaway & sweepstakes department, starting with the 100k Grand Prize of our first giveaway. * Always helping guildies, and on board to keep backing the guild bank for future giveaways. 3. — Junior Officer #3 Iksar · MNK/PAL/WIZ * Dedicated to guild raids — a veteran member always lending a helping hand. * Super active in guild events. A model guildie turned raider, now Junior Officer. * Stepping up as a Dungeon Crawl or Raid Leader — his call, his schedule. MORE TO FOLLOW — STILL RECRUITING RAID & DUNGEON CRAWL LEADERS More Junior Officer promotions are coming, alongside new for anyone eager to host raids or crawls — in-game, in Discord, or both. * Host 1-2 runs a week, around your schedule. * Your team name, your crew, your way · voice optional. * AFK, vacation, IRL? No minimum, no penalty. Life first. * Player quest hosting, event coordination, and public zone invasions optional! Active, level 25+, drama-free and enjoy leading? DM Kinzo or /tell Kinzo in game. We rise. We fight. We live on. -

1544948463119368264.headline: GUILD PROMOTION — Officer #14 - Aani - Raid Leader · Afterlife, Freeport Server Good news! The officer vote is in and it was unanimous — 100% in favor. & Please join me in congratulating (in <#1528946
1544948463119368264.body: GUILD PROMOTION — Officer #14 - Aani - Raid Leader · Afterlife, Freeport Server Good news! The officer vote is in and it was unanimous — 100% in favor. & Please join me in congratulating (in <#1528946135149051989>) as he is our 14th officer of Afterlife, and our newest Raid Leader. What earned it: - Three weeks straight running D0/D1 on Yael, Naggy and Vox, walking 40-50 range guildies through their very first clears. - Helping members finish Sky Key sets alongside Hezz, Smacky and crew PLUS recruited 6 active members into the guild. - A deep MMO leadership resume — Lead Enchanter with Echoes of Eternity in classic EQ, guild leader in FFXI, raid leader and co-GM in WoW. That's exactly the kind of officer we want carrying forward the Afterlife name and legacy as a tribute guild. Go say hello to Aani and grab a spot in one of his upcoming raids! WE ARE STILL RECRUITING RAID LEADERS — 10 SPOTS OPEN Consider this our official "now hiring" call. We're near 300 weekly active members but only posting 1-2 organized raid teams a week. The goal: 10-30 raids posted and hosted weekly, run by different leaders under different team names, so you can sign up with whoever fits your schedule and playstyle. Joined by & as our other official Raid Leaders. Now and still looking for more! What the role actually is: - Host 1-2 weekly reset raids — scheduled entirely around your availability - Your own team name, your own crew, your own way of running it - Discord voice chat is optional — every raid leader calls that for their own runs - AFK, vacation, IRL? No minimum, no penalty. Life first. - Promotion to Officer comes with it! If you're active, level 25+, drama-free and you enjoy leading, we want you. DM Kinzo directly on Discord or send an in-game /tell to Kinzo. More content and bigger raids are coming to EQL. The guild with the deepest bench of leaders owns the server when it lands. Let's make it The Afterlife. *We rise. We fight. We live on.* -

There’s always one unwelcome guest at Labor Day get-togethers, snappily dressed in yellow and black stripes and always looking for a fight… This year, when you hear that loud buzzing, don’t panic, don’t reach for the bug spray - this one's yours! We are giving away our very first petamorph wand, the Murderbee, to all players this weekend! You can claim it on the in-game Marketplace for 0 IR from September 4 to 7, 2026 ONLY! Don't miss it! It pays to know how to handle your Murderbee properly, lest you get stung! - To use the wand, first place it in your Inventory, under Activated Item Storage. - It will appear as an option in the “Illusion” drop-down within the Pet tab of your inventory. - Once it is selected, any combat pet you summon will use the Murderbee illusion! - If you are not running a pet class in your loadout, you can right-click the item at any time to create a Murderbee familiar, a non-combat pet. Get the buzz going! Bonus XP Weekend! As summer finally starts to wind down, and we have one more glorious weekend to relax and play! Log in from Sept 4 to 7, 2026 for 25% Bonus XP in EverQuest Legends. Catch up to your friends and top up those levels! [EDIT 09/02/26: The bonus XP also applies to AA experience gains!]

1540825685352779876.headline: GUILD-WIDE EVENT: PUBLIC INVADE / PLANE OF SKY RUN - VOTE NOW! Hi all! Today I'd like to propose an idea that came up with in guild chat last night. Thought it was such a great idea that we should pos
1540825685352779876.body: GUILD-WIDE EVENT: PUBLIC INVADE / PLANE OF SKY RUN - VOTE NOW! Hi all! Today I'd like to propose an idea that came up with in guild chat last night. Thought it was such a great idea that we should post a poll to gauge interest. Our goal is to take group photos and have some fun! The pitch: We take Plane of Sky (the old "Plane of Air") and split into multiple groups farming all public zone difficulty levels. All of Sky, all at once. Why now: Using the pick zone action, so anyone who shows up gets slotted into a layer and can request to join up. Hopping layers to visit other guildies. The more we bring, the more ground we cover. Timing — pick your poison: • Friday night (September 4th?) — We're usually sitting just under 100 online! • Saturday night (September 5th?) — We clear 110+ online! How it'll run: • Each group or raid takes a section of different difficulty level of the zone, and use /shout to make our presence known. • Groups break into their own voice channels, so group leaders should click "Create Channel" then ask their party/raid to join it. • Stampy and Lehoric plus group/raid leaders can coordinate in guild chat, so like maybe one island per so not crowding each other. What I need from you: react with a if interested in attending an event like this. React with a ‍ if not sure. React with a if not. Then, CAST YOUR VOTE for which option you choose. Vote here so we can lock the date.... Let's put a 50+ number on the board, for our first guild-wide event. What do you think? Post about it in <#1528946135149051989> -Kinzo

1539429866951417866.headline: # 21 DAYS IN — 257 STRONG <Afterlife> in EQL is officially three weeks old today, Launch Tuesday to Patch Tuesday! — we just crossed 257 members. What changed in three days: - 236 → 257 members — 22 n
1539429866951417866.body: # 21 DAYS IN — 257 STRONG <Afterlife> in EQL is officially three weeks old today, Launch Tuesday to Patch Tuesday! — we just crossed 257 members. What changed in three days: - 236 → 257 members — 22 new names, and 235 of the 236 from last census are still here (99.6%) - Level 50s: 85 → 113 — nearly 44% of the guild is at cap - 1,136 levels gained in 72 hours • average 40, median 47 - 182 of you logged in on census day — up from 106 - Hate overtook Sky — 25 members in the Plane of Hate when the dump fired, our biggest single concentration ever New this census — the number the roster can't see. The dump reports whatever loadout you're wearing, not how far you've actually got. 34% of you changed trios in three days. have fun leveling your alts, and quick switch to your mains for raiding! Shoutout to — his three AI ideas got built into a full proposal (just for fun) maybe for our DEV and close friend care of might be interesting to you! For all our members situational awareness, please see the second PDF attached - we want your feedback! (Maybe) a true max-level ledger, (Maybe) a Magelo-style power board/website, (maybe not) a Plane of Sky unlock tracker are just a couple ideas that the guild + AI wrote up in this edition of our latest guild report data. Neat! Two PDFs attached. Regarding the attached proposal document, not sure if we should or shouldn't build them but please see attached. we want your feedback! Read the attached and tell us which one you want to see in the <#1532744753718755418>. Got an idea of your own? DM — good ones get built with your name on them. Note: I'm working with Claude Opus 5 with max effort turned on.

1538094469499330680.headline: # 18 DAYS IN — UPDATED GUILD CENSUS <Afterlife> is 18 days into EverQuest Legends, and the guild has completely changed shape. What changed since the Day-6 report: - 188 → 236 members — 64 new names,
1538094469499330680.body: # 18 DAYS IN — UPDATED GUILD CENSUS <Afterlife> is 18 days into EverQuest Legends, and the guild has completely changed shape. What changed since the Day-6 report: - 188 → 236 members — 64 new names, and 172 of the original 188 (91%) still here - Level 50s: 25 → 85 — a 3.4× jump in twelve days - 145 members are now level 40+ • average level 32 → 38 (median 46) - Endgame is home now — most of us were in Plane of Sky, Plane of Hate, and Nagafen's Lair at census time By the numbers (Day-18 census): - 236 members — still the largest active guild on Freeport - With our 3-class flexibility we can field 59 balanced dungeons or 29 raids at the same time - 206 of 236 (87%) were online within the last 72 hours The gap that hasn't closed: 70% of us still main a plate tank (81 Paladins alone) — content only wants 25%. You don't need to reroll. Just swap your loadout to the healer or DPS class already sitting in your 2nd or 3rd slot. - Still zero mains across Necromancer, Wizard, Enchanter, Berserker, Beastlord - Rarest overall: Beastlord (11), Magician (16), Ranger (16) — roll one and you'll never sit out Officer corps update: welcome Zalbaag and Masked to the officer ranks — both OG Afterlife from the EQ1 days. o7 Legends Unite is live and in daily use — head to <#1532087433665974464> to host or join runs. STILL HIRING (roleplaying): Dungeon Leaders & Raid Leaders (Junior Officer roles). Host on your own schedule — DM Kinzo to apply. Full report attached — complete class breakdown, capacity math, role-mix analysis, and the entire 236-member roster. o7 Contact: DM

1536439691212095516.headline: ===> THE MEMBERS & OFFICERS HAVE VOTED — IT PASSED! Today, August 10th 2026, two new Junior Officer roles have been announced. Happy to report that we have our first two names to add to the new Guild
1536439691212095516.body: ===> THE MEMBERS & OFFICERS HAVE VOTED — IT PASSED! Today, August 10th 2026, two new Junior Officer roles have been announced. Happy to report that we have our first two names to add to the new Guild Field Promotions list! Both will be promoted to Officer in-game today and will carry the new title here in Discord too. Working with on the discord title config. Congrats! & Everyone, please help me in congratulating Lehoric and Stampy. Our first two members that earned the Dungeon Leader & Raid Leader titles! — JUNIOR OFFICER · DUNGEON LEADER Title granted as requested: "First of His Kind, Lehoric Dawnblade the Dungeon Master" — Level 38 Gnome · PAL/BER/ENC Description: Tank and crowd control in the same body, which is exactly why our dungeon clears hold together instead of falling apart on the third pull. He'll be posting scheduled dungeon crawls/runs each week through the Legends Unite Bot. He was also the first to raise a hand for the officer track. If you're leveling, hit up Lehoric to run some Dungeons! — JUNIOR OFFICER · RAID LEADER Title as assigned: Stampy the Raiding Legend — Level 50 Ogre · PAL/MNK/ENC Description: Main tank, puller, and crowd control in a single raid slot. First to 50 that also led a guild raid, and many successful D4 through D0 clears already banked. He runs them live in voice with a stream up and posts the kill shots in our screenshot channel. He'll schedule the week ahead through the Legends Unite bot. Want to raid? Hit up Stampy! Congrats to you both!! Well deserved, and thanks for all you do for our guildies! ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ STILL ACCEPTING — DUNGEON LEADERS & RAID LEADERS More Junior Officer seats are open and we want more volunteers! What the role actually is... - Like 2 hosted events per week minimum — about 4 is the target! - Scheduled a week ahead, around your availability at different times. - Live in a voice channel, stream up, kill shots posted for all to see. How you get the Field Promotion... - Bring a roleplay-based gaming resume for fun. - Meeting 1-on-1 with me, then an optional group interview with 2+ officers. - Private Officer vote, public Member vote — you get the outcome. - Pass = promoted. No pass = re-apply in 30 days. Interested? Contact: DM -- Thank you, all! Have a wonderful week ahead! Kind regards, -Kinzo <#1536274234605703228>

1533093746395189269.headline: Attention BIG NEWS! We're excited to announce that on August 1st 2026 we're officially LIVE and just launched our brand new discord bot named "Legends Unite" and we think you will love it! We really w
1533093746395189269.body: Attention BIG NEWS! We're excited to announce that on August 1st 2026 we're officially LIVE and just launched our brand new discord bot named "Legends Unite" and we think you will love it! We really want you to try it and give us your feedback. It's a new, home grown, LFG/LFM tool that's ready to use. It's really a "Looking for Group, Dungeon or Raid" platform to help you find, host and play more easily together in EQL. In a solo oriented game, we wanted to bring more guild groups daily, more voice activity/streams, and more weekly discord participation while growing our community. Please see the "<#1532087433665974464>" channel to start using it. We urge you to please use the Looking For Group or Raid section at the top of our discord server and be sure to monitor/view the forum channels to JOIN, HOST NOW or SCHEDULE future dated events. Try to join some each week! What channel do you use to get started? This one... Special big THANK YOU to for all his hard work and long hours this past week building, updating and testing this awesome new app! Please monitor the bot-patch-notes channel for a change log. Please give us feedback in the bot-feedback-channel for sharing your suggestions and your questions. Please right-click your discord name in our discord server, choose "edit per-server profile" and you should adjust it to your in-game character name. Thank you! Please use and enjoy! -Kinzo HOW TO NAVIGATE THE NEW DISCORD SECTION! - Basic Overview If you're looking to sign-up to join an already created group, dungeon or raid, do this... Look for the "[LFG/LFR] Looking For Group or Raid?" at the top of our discord server, click to view and sign up to attend. 1. <#1532930294880010422> = Available open-world zone groups. Hosted by folks farming, leveling or questing. 2. <#1532176988754673794> = Available dungeons that fall on a weekday. 3. <#1532177144078405832> = Available raids that fall on a weekday. 4. <#1532087433665974464> = This is used to interact with the bot and for creating events. 5. <#1532744753718755418> = This is where we welcome your feedback and to report any questions/concerns. 6. <#1532807979244716112> = This is where you'll see the changelog for the Legends Unite bot. HOW TO USE THE BOT! - Basic Guide Step 0: If you get an error "Legends Unite didn't respond in time." and if the bot is showing offline and not online, please wait and report this to in DM and in the <#1532744753718755418>. Step 1: Normally the bot will always be online! So next click to the <#1532087433665974464> channel and choose "Open Interaction" to get started! Step 2: Click on the "Legends Unite — Your Discord Name" Thread that gets created and follow the on-screen prompts to proceed. Step 3: You'll click to set your Character Name and Class/Role Information. This info is saved for future use. Step 4: Click to create your Group, Dungeon or Raid event (for right now, or future dated) follow the on-screen information. Step 5: You're done! Just be sure to sign up to attend your own Group, Dungeon or Raid. You will see your event posted in the proper forum channel to chat with those who sign up to attend too. DONE! The bot will auto-create a voice channel for your event 15 minutes prior to the start time. Everything auto cleans up once the event expires. It even reminds you which voice channel to join. Voice chatting/streaming not required but welcomed! See attached for where to get started.

1532895331249950770.body: Good news we've successfully reached our Level 3 discord boost goal. Woohoo! Thank you and we may now pause any further boosts at this time. Thank you so much, everyone! We're living on with the Afterlife together in their honor, always. Be sure to represent the name respectfully, operating at an elite level of kind/casual or hardcore too! Looking forward to seeing many party, groups and raids with the new bot launching soon so you all can HD stream your game now! Ideally getting one or more HD streams going in each group, dungeon or raid. By hosting or joining to aid you in your Norrath journey through the Afterlife together. (Even those soloing can jump in muted to watch so the more discord activity, the more fun for all! Kind regards, ever to serve, -Kinzo)

1530745163981262919.body: # HELP US BOOST — EQL AFTERLIFE TO LEVEL 3! -- *Afterlife • Freeport Server* <#1528946134918234304> Legends! It's time to rally for our home base! ## Goal: Reach a LEVEL 3 Boosted Server! Getting Afterlife to Level 3 — powered entirely by our own community — is our #1 priority. These perks genuinely upgrade how we play, grow, and represent: Crystal-clear raid comms — best audio quality + 1080p streaming for clean voice and sharp gameplay sharing on group nights & raids nights too Bigger uploads for everyone — post clips, screenshots, guides & parses without hitting the wall Guild identity & prestige — custom server banner, animated icon & custom role icons to make Afterlife look as legendary as the name it honors Easy recruiting — a clean custom invite link + polished invite background = a killer first impression for new Legends More culture — 250 emoji + 60 sticker slots for days ## Where We Stand: 3 boosts so far — massive thanks to our current boosters! Level 3 requires 14 boosts total Just 11 more to reach our goal! *(Bonus: we hit Level 2 at 7 boosts — only 4 away — on the way up!)* ## How to Help: Tap the server name → Server Boost (or Server Settings → Server Boost) and hit "Boost This Server." Boosting needs Discord Nitro — and a Nitro sub includes 2 boosts, so one Nitro alone knocks out 2 of the 11! Every boost gets us closer. Plus unlocks a special title for you in our server! Let's build the guild home our Legends deserve. TY! - (Guild Master)

1529741755564556369.headline: Afterlife_in_EQL_End_of_Beta_Report_Version2_on_07232026 My fellow guildies, so happy to report we logged our member base and friends of friends that joined AL, all entering the Afterlife in EQL! It w
1529741755564556369.body: Afterlife_in_EQL_End_of_Beta_Report_Version2_on_07232026 My fellow guildies, so happy to report we logged our member base and friends of friends that joined AL, all entering the Afterlife in EQL! It was funny in tracking the census data. So many deleted their characters! I think we got 'about' most of the beta members and learned a thing or two on how to make this census + ops update/report better in the future. Especially when it matters most at launch and beyond, for real! Excellent beta start and finish and utilized the data I logged along the way for the screenshots and the PDF attached that most importantly I'd like you all to review. Thank you! and looking forward to more dialoging and feedback in our chat rooms. We're still working on but loving our official EQL discord and special thanks to for really coming through for us with such a generous amount of time contributed to help us spin up this discord before the wipe too! Happy to report that the end of beta report is ready for your review. It was a really good beta because it helped us improve our more accurate theory crafting on what all we liked and didn't like about originally what we had in mind. Thought it may be worth the Claude AI credits (haha) to test and check against what all we learned and the data and the census info we had. Think this helps us get a better picture of what all the class combinations amounted to for impact viability and for future theory crafting decisions for launch! We're a growing community of former EQ1 and new EQL gamers alike! To embracing a larger community model and implement ways to make sure it's super easy for everyone to host and/or sign up to attend any number of dungeons and raids on a variety of difficulties! To benefit all! One thing I learned in beta was that the game could be a lot of people soloing, or, we should and are developing a LFM tool to expand our daily active discord voice and chat activity too! -Kinzo

1519015003427049602.body: From Secrets at 10:20 AM PDT: Najena has received a touch-up! Adventurers level 15-30 exploring the zone can expect to see smoother NPC level progression, new named, new drops, loot improvements, and a striking lack of placeholders for named mobs. On a completely unrelated note, I could swear my Journeyman's Boots are 1% faster... ~Secrets [but wait, there's more, she just can't contain herself...] Raids now have a bonus loot lockout system where if you are in that lockout you will only receive 1 piece of loot per named raid creature that has its own lockout. 1504209146029801533.headline: EQL Insights - Spotlight on our Creators! Hello Legends! We’re excited to announce that will be opening up streaming from the EQ Legends beta server beginning this Friday, May 15 at 9:00 AM PDT! Wheth
1504209146029801533.body: EQL Insights - Spotlight on our Creators! Hello Legends! We’re excited to announce that will be opening up streaming from the EQ Legends beta server beginning this Friday, May 15 at 9:00 AM PDT! Whether you are currently in the beta, a beta hopeful, or interested in seeing more of the game, we hope you will enjoy the upcoming video, streaming, wiki and fansite content! Please note: The beta nondisclosure agreement (NDA) will continue to apply to the EQ Legends Discord server and any nonpublic information shared in that channel until the NDA is fully lifted. This includes any planned game features or other information that has not yet been publicly announced. Also, please remember, the game is still in beta. There are bugs, unfinished features, and game balancing changes that we will continue to address between now and launch. We welcome your feedback while asking that you keep the discussions about the game constructive and centered on having fun. Be sure to tune in to the video, streamer and wiki channels on our [Discord]( this Friday to get all the content anyone could possibly ask for! Finally, we’re also excited to announce that we have released another 1,000 beta keys today! Good luck and see you soon in EQ Legends! Dave “Sysyphus” Youssefi Executive Producer, EverQuest Legends
